templates.title: SkySend
templates.name: skysend
templates.description: SkySend is a self-hosted file and note sharing service. Files and notes are encrypted in the browser before they are stored, and the server keeps only encrypted blobs.

env.name: BASE_URL
env.label: BASE_URL
env.description: Public URL used in share links. Matches the published host port.

env.name: DATA_DIR
env.label: DATA_DIR
env.description: Database and persistent data. Matches the data volume.

env.name: UPLOADS_DIR
env.label: UPLOADS_DIR
env.description: Encrypted file storage. Matches the uploads volume.
